title: Spare +
lines: Polyester covers provided a decent amount of hook back in the 70’s. Today, they make perfect spare balls due to the low friction levels they create on modern bowling environments.
This one comes with a 800, 1000, 2000 Abralon® Polished with Power House Factory Finish Polish. This finish is perfect for picking up spares and for drier lane conditions.
Finish | 800, 800, 1000,2000 Abralon® Polished with Power House Factory Finish
